verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no in-product AI insights or suggestions feature for Okta. The open-source MCP server lets external LLMs and agents query and manage Okta data in natural language, but that is a developer building block used from outside the product, not AI-generated insights delivered inside Okta, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
